data.name: Sample - ThreatConnect - 2.2.1
data.description: Sample playbooks for ThreatConnect: indicator lookups and changes, and scheduled ingestion. Clone these into a separate collection before customizing - the sample collection is replaced on connector upgrade.

workflows.name: Get IP Reputation
workflows.description: Retrieves the reputation for a specific IP address using the ThreatConnect API based on the IP address and other input parameters you have specified

workflows.name: Get File Reputation
workflows.description: Retrieves the reputation of a specific file hash using the ThreatConnect API based on the file hash and other input parameters you have specified

workflows.name: Get Email Reputation
workflows.description: Retrieves the reputation for a specific email address using the ThreatConnect API based on the email address and other input parameters you have specified.

workflows.name: Get URL Reputation
workflows.description: Retrieves the reputation of a specific URL using the ThreatConnect API based on the URL address and other input parameters you have specified.

workflows.name: Get Host Reputation
workflows.description: Retrieves the reputation of a specific host using the ThreatConnect API based on the hostname and other input parameters you have specified.

workflows.name: List Indicator
workflows.description: Retrieves indicators using the ThreatConnect API based on the input parameters you have specified

workflows.name: Invoke ThreatConnect REST API
workflows.description: Invokes a function to 'Get an API' endpoint on the ThreatConnect server based on the endpoint you have specified.

workflows.name: Create Indicator
workflows.description: Creates an indicator with a rating, confidence, tags and a security label. An indicator that already exists in the owner is updated.

workflows.name: Update Indicator
workflows.description: Adds a tag and raises the rating of an existing indicator.

workflows.name: Mark False Positive
workflows.description: Flags an indicator as a false positive.

workflows.name: List Owners
workflows.description: Lists the organizations, communities and sources the credentials can see.

workflows.name: Get Indicators
workflows.description: Manually fetch indicators from ThreatConnect. Diagnostic / on-demand.

workflows.name: > ThreatConnect > Fetch and Create
workflows.description: Fetch and create indicators from ThreatConnect. Called as a child workflow.

step_variables._configuration_schema: [{"title": "Indicator Type Filter", "name": "indicator_type", "type": "select", "required": false, "editable": true, "visible": true, "options": ["Any", "Address", "Host", "URL", "EmailAddress", "File"], "value": "Any", "tooltip": "Restrict ingestion to a single ThreatConnect indicator type. 'Any' pulls all types."}, {"title": "Owner Filter (Optional)", "name": "owner", "type": "text", "required": false, "editable": true, "visible": true, "tooltip": "Restrict ingestion to indicators owned by this Source/Community/Organization. Defaults to the connector's Default Organization."}, {"title": "Ingestion Begin From", "name": "last_pull_datetime", "type": "datetime", "required": false, "editable": true, "visible": true, "tooltip": "Pull only indicators modified at or after this datetime. Updated automatically by the scheduler after each run."}, {"title": "Reputation", "name": "reputation", "type": "select", "required": true, "editable": true, "visible": true, "options": ["Good", "Suspicious", "Malicious", "No Reputation Available", "TBD"], "value": "Suspicious", "tooltip": "Default reputation applied to ingested indicators."}, {"title": "TLP", "name": "tlp", "type": "select", "required": false, "editable": true, "visible": true, "options": ["Red", "Amber", "Green", "White"], "value": "Amber"}, {"title": "Confidence", "name": "confidence", "type": "integer", "required": false, "editable": true, "visible": true, "value": 75, "validation": {"minlength": 0, "maxlength": 100}, "tooltip": "Default confidence applied when an indicator does not carry one."}, {"title": "Maximum Age (in days)", "name": "expiry", "type": "integer", "required": false, "editable": true, "visible": true, "value": 30}, {"title": "Per-Run Limit (Optional)", "name": "limit", "type": "integer", "required": false, "editable": true, "visible": true, "tooltip": "Cap indicators ingested per run. Leave blank for full pagination."}]

arguments.reputation_map: {'Good': {{'IndicatorReputation' | picklist('Good') }}, 'Malicious': {{'IndicatorReputation' | picklist('Malicious') }}, 'Suspicious': {{'IndicatorReputation' | picklist('Suspicious') }}, 'TBD': {{'IndicatorReputation' | picklist('TBD') }}, 'No Reputation Available': {{'IndicatorReputation' | picklist('No Reputation Available') }}}
arguments.type_of_feed_map: {'Address': {{'ThreatIntelFeedType' | picklist('IPv4 Address') }}, 'Host': {{'ThreatIntelFeedType' | picklist('Domain') }}, 'EmailAddress': {{'ThreatIntelFeedType' | picklist('Email Address') }}, 'URL': {{'ThreatIntelFeedType' | picklist('URL') }}, 'File': {{'ThreatIntelFeedType' | picklist('FileHash-SHA256') }}, 'FileMD5': {{'ThreatIntelFeedType' | picklist('FileHash-MD5') }}, 'FileSHA1': {{'ThreatIntelFeedType' | picklist('FileHash-SHA1') }}}

resource.value: {% if vars.item.type == 'File' %}{{ vars.item.summary.split(' : ')|last }}{% else %}{{ vars.item.summary }}{% endif %}
resource.typeOfFeed: {{ (('FileMD5' if (vars.item.summary.split(' : ')|last|length) == 32 else 'FileSHA1' if (vars.item.summary.split(' : ')|last|length) == 40 else 'File') if vars.item.type == 'File' else vars.item.type) | resolveRange(vars.type_of_feed_map) }}
resource.tLP: {% if vars.tlp %}{{ vars.tlp | resolveRange(vars.tlp_map) }}{% else %}None{% endif %}
resource.reputation: {% if vars.reputation %}{{ vars.reputation | resolveRange(vars.reputation_map) }}{% else %}None{% endif %}
resource.confidence: {% if vars.confidence %}{{ vars.confidence }}{% else %}{{ (vars.item.confidence | int) }}{% endif %}
resource.expiresOn: {% if vars.expiry %}{{ arrow.utcnow().int_timestamp + (vars.expiry | int)*24*60*60 }}{% else %}None{% endif %}
